minimal_240.claim: numerical pipeline / geometry / stability smoke test; liquid inventory is diagnostic, not a formal conservation gate
minimal_240.of350_parameter_status: OF350_TRANSFER_BASELINE: source-backed values for the next reduced baseline, not universally measured EC1 material properties
minimal_240.model: OpenLB conservative phase field plus Liang coupling, sigma=0, periodic-x representative crop
minimal_240.gas_approximation: reduced incompressible phase, rho_g=151 kg/m3; not perfectGas
minimal_240.drive: quintic-ramped uniform x acceleration 1e-6 lattice units

p0_pressing.claim: candidate moving-control-volume conservation algorithm stress test; not a physical EC1 100-to-80 um groove-compression process or upper-film trajectory
p0_pressing.formulation: two-phase finite-volume q_l=h*alpha_l and q_g=h*(1-alpha_l), no alpha rescale or clipping
p0_pressing.reuse_rule: if reused, h denotes upper-film/reduced control-volume thickness, never fixed 100 um groove depth

p1a_oas_depth_transport.claim: real-OAS conservative sidecar transport test for a numerical moving-control-volume scenario; not physical EC1 driving validation
p1a_oas_depth_transport.formulation: finite-volume q_l=h*alpha_l and q_g=h*(1-alpha_l) routed through real OAS right-edge outlets; no alpha rescaling or clipping
p1a_oas_depth_transport.scope: real-OAS conservative depth-transport evidence; not an OpenLB collision/coupling or physical-driving validation result
p1a_oas_depth_transport.reuse_rule: if reused, h denotes upper-film/reduced control-volume thickness, never fixed 100 um groove depth

known_limitations: Minimal 240 is a 2-D OAS representative crop, not a full 1 mm board or a z-resolved groove simulation.
The simplified gas is not OpenFOAM perfectGas and the periodic boundary is not an EC1 process boundary.
Surface tension, Darcy, calibrated wetting, and an OAS/OpenLB moving-depth coupling are not enabled; P1A is an independent candidate-scenario depth-transport sidecar.
The frozen physical interpretation has fixed 100 um grooves and a separate upper film: 1.0 um initially, squeezed toward about 65 nm by a -0.935 um, 1 s OF350-quintic template descent.
The earlier pressure-open minimal exploration was stable but did not move the front sufficiently and had 0.282 inventory residual; it remains a diagnostic HOLD, not the selected baseline.
